freshness.note: Dashboard interpretation treats snapshots up to 4 hours old as current. Actual age is measured from the last closed source candle, never from file generation time.

window_semantics: Trailing half-open UTC intervals [start_utc, end_utc_exclusive). Binance Spot uses validated closed 1m klines; Gate perpetual uses separately validated closed-minute trade aggregates on the same requested boundary.

definitions.cvd_quote_usdt: sum(taker_buy_quote_volume - taker_sell_quote_volume), where taker_sell_quote_volume = quote_volume - taker_buy_quote_volume
definitions.provider_separation: Spot and perpetual observations retain their own exchange, endpoint, instrument, timestamp, coverage, and integrity. Values are not merged across providers.

usd_m_futures.aggressor_side_rule: positive trade size = taker buy; negative trade size = taker sell

btc_spot_price.coverage: close of the latest validated closed BTCUSDT 1m Spot candle

funding.coverage: per-exchange BTC perpetual metrics; no cross-exchange aggregation
